name: Tightlining / waterline liner

lead: Tightlining is a makeup technique in which liner is applied right against the lash roots, under the upper lashes and above the lower lashes, so lashes look fuller and the lash line darker. Waterline liner is applied to the inner rim of the lid.
In looksmaxxing talk it is mentioned as a way to make eyes look defined or deeper-set. No studies of that claim were found.

paras: Dark pigment fills the gaps between lashes and at the lid margin, which can make lashes look denser and longer. Waterproof products are commonly preferred for this technique.
Liner placed at the lid margin sits very close to the eye surface. No studies on the technique were found in the sources reviewed.

lead: Tightlining is a method of eyeliner application in which liner is placed close to the waterline, under the upper lashes and above the lower lashes. Waterproof products are usually preferred, and the technique can make lashes appear longer [1].
Proponents in appearance communities say it defines the eyes and suggests depth. No published research was found on how tightlining changes perceived eye shape or attractiveness.

paras: Wikipedia describes tight lining as one of several eyeliner styles alongside kohl, winged and cat eye applications [1]. Eyeliners come in liquid, pencil, gel and other forms [1].
